description: This file implements peephole optimizations for list idioms in TorchScript JIT compiler, including list length refinement and list operation simplifications.

classes.name: ListLenRefiner
classes.description: Performs list length refinement analysis to optimize list length operations.

classes.name: PeepholeOptimizeListIdiomsImpl
classes.description: Implements the peephole optimization pass for list idioms, including list slicing, concatenation, and length simplification.

methods.name: normalizeIndex
methods.description: Normalizes a possibly negative index relative to list length.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the optimization pass on the graph.

methods.name: collectListsToRefine
methods.description: Collects list values that have multiple uses of 'len' and are not mutated.

methods.name: RefineListLens
methods.description: Refines list length information within a block.

methods.name: tryFindRefinement
methods.description: Attempts to find a list length refinement for a given value.

methods.name: checkForMutatedList
methods.description: Checks if a list value has writers, indicating mutation.

methods.name: collectMutatedLists
methods.description: Recursively collects all mutated list values in the graph.

methods.name: optimizeSlice
methods.description: Optimizes list slice operations when possible.

methods.name: runBlock
methods.description: Runs optimization on a block of nodes.
